title: And… They’re Off
summary: So it begins – another earnings season is upon us. As we noted yesterday, this week’s reports are heavily skewed toward the financial sector with a few key stocks in other businesses seemingly thrown in for good measure. It is always tempting to extrapolate the first day’s results to the whole of the reporting period, but today’s reactions make it even more difficult than normal. We learned plenty about the goings-on at specific companies, but little to base further opinions upon.
